name: notifyjs-monorepo
description: NotifyJS — embed a notification hub in your app, reach every device you own.

scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run build -w @notifyjs/protocol && npm run build -w @notifyjs/core && npm run build -w @notifyjs/web && npm run build -w @notifyjs/cli
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/mobile/assets packages/web/public/icon.svg packages/web/public/favicon.png
scripts.binary: npm run build && npm run bundle && node scripts/package.mjs --target node20-linux-x64 --name notifyjs-linux-x64
